title: Battle of Mendigorría
text: The Battle of Mendigorría took place during the First Carlist War on July 16, 1835 south of Mendigorría, Navarre. The Carlists were commanded by Vicente González Moreno, who assumed the post after the death of Tomás de Zumalacárregui at the Siege of Bilbao. The Carlist pretender, Don Carlos, was also at Mendigorría.
